normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is the sole parameter of setOwner and is written directly into the owner state variable
_admin is the sole parameter and is stored directly into the admin state variable
_newMonitor is the sole parameter and is stored in newMonitor for the delayed promotion
_amount is the trade amount used to compute the fee and is enforced against the 20% cap
_user is only used to read the custom discount fee for that account
_gasCost is converted through the oracle and added to the fee amount
_tokenAddr selects whether the fee is sent as ETH or as an ERC20 transfer
exData carries the src/dest addresses, amounts and calldata that drive the swap
_exData carries the offchain callData and exchange address used for the low-level call
_data is the arbitrary calldata forwarded by the proxy, the core of the unsafe execute operation
_target is the arbitrary contract the proxy calls with the supplied value and data
v/r/s are only used in the ecrecover check and nonce bookkeeping of the meta transaction
_nonce is only used for replay protection inside the same meta-transaction function
_cdpId identifies the subscriber entry and is validated against manager.owns
feeAmount is the exact value that is transferred out of the contract to the wallet
swapAmount is the intermediate swap result consumed by paybackDebt or mint in repay
maxColl bounds the redemption amount in repay and is never persisted
borrowAmount is the borrow size clamped by max borrow inside boost
loanAmount is the exact parameter passed to lendingPool.flashLoan
maxDebt limits how much Dai is drawn during the repay automation flow
amount is the transient amount deposited or repaid and does not need a separate node
destAmount is the transient swap output returned to the caller of _sell
feeAmount is the capped Dai fee immediately transferred to the wallet inside takeFee
